conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Algorithmic bias occurs when an AI system produces unfair or discriminatory outcomes due to biased data used in its training. This can lead to skewed results that disadvantage certain groups or individuals.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For example, facial recognition software might be less accurate for certain demographics, or loan approval algorithms could unfairly reject applications based on historical lending biases.
